title: Chamelidevi Flour Mills received in-principle approval from BSE SME | Stock Market News
summary: Chamelidevi Flour Mills Limited, an agro-processing company, has received approval for its Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP), planning to issue 58,20,000 equity shares for a fresh issue. The proceeds will be used for expanding its facilities and working capital, aiming to enhance operational efficiency and support growth initiatives.
sentiment_reason: The article presents a positive sentiment as it discusses the company's strategic plans for growth and expansion through a fresh equity issue, indicating a strong market position and potential for future success.
